local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
assert(not player.PlayerScripts:FindFirstChild("CornAudioLiveTrace"))
local scriptObject = Instance.new("LocalScript")
scriptObject.Name = "CornAudioLiveTrace"
scriptObject:SetAttribute("corn_test_owned", true)
scriptObject.Source = [[
local player=game.Players.LocalPlayer
local report=Instance.new("StringValue")
report.Name="CornAudioLiveReport"
report.Parent=player.PlayerScripts
local runtime=workspace.CornMap.CornRoundRuntime
local begun=os.clock()
local result={done=false,duration=0,events={},roles={},stateChanges={},hunt={},cricketSegments={},maxVoices=0,footsteps={}}
local connections,watched={},{}
local lastState,lastHunt=nil,-100
local function watch(item)
 if not item:IsA("Sound") or watched[item] or item:GetAttribute("CornAudioOwned")~=true then return end
 local path=item:GetFullName()
 watched[item]=path
 table.insert(connections,item.Played:Connect(function()
  if #result.events<250 then table.insert(result.events,{at=os.clock()-begun,role=item:GetAttribute("audio_role"),key=item:GetAttribute("AudioAssetKey"),path=path}) end
 end))
end
local function visit(container)
 if container then for _,item in container:GetDescendants() do watch(item) end end
end
visit(game.SoundService:FindFirstChild("CornPersonalAudio"))
for _,folder in runtime:GetChildren() do if folder.Name:sub(1,15)=="CornRoundAudio_" then visit(folder) end end
visit(runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster"))
visit(workspace.CornMap:FindFirstChild("TorchMarkers"))
visit(player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"))
table.insert(connections,runtime.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch))
if player.Character then table.insert(connections,player.Character.DescendantAdded:Connect(watch)) end
while os.clock()-begun<120 do
 local at=os.clock()-begun
 local monster=runtime:FindFirstChild("Monster")
 local state=monster and monster:GetAttribute("HuntState") or "stopped"
 if state~=lastState then table.insert(result.stateChanges,{at=at,state=state,target=monster and monster:GetAttribute("ChaseTargetUserId")});lastState=state end
 local voices=0
 for sound,path in watched do
  if sound.Parent then
   local role=sound:GetAttribute("audio_role")
   local entry=result.roles[path] or {role=role,loaded=false,playingSamples=0,maxPosition=0,maxLoudness=0,maxVolume=0}
   result.roles[path]=entry
   entry.loaded=entry.loaded or sound.IsLoaded
   if sound.IsPlaying then entry.playingSamples+=1 end
   entry.maxPosition=math.max(entry.maxPosition,sound.TimePosition)
   entry.maxLoudness=math.max(entry.maxLoudness,sound.PlaybackLoudness)
   entry.maxVolume=math.max(entry.maxVolume,sound.Volume)
   if role=="hunt" and (sound.IsPlaying or state=="chase" or at-lastHunt<3) then
    if sound.IsPlaying or state=="chase" then lastHunt=at end
    if #result.hunt<120 then table.insert(result.hunt,{at=at,state=state,playing=sound.IsPlaying,volume=sound.Volume,pos=sound.TimePosition}) end
   end
   if role=="crickets" then
    local segments=result.cricketSegments[path] or {};result.cricketSegments[path]=segments
    local prev=segments[#segments]
    if not prev or prev.playing~=sound.IsPlaying then table.insert(segments,{at=at,playing=sound.IsPlaying,pos=sound.TimePosition}) end
   end
   if role and role:sub(1,14)=="monster_voice_" and sound.IsPlaying then voices+=1 end
  end
 end
 result.maxVoices=math.max(result.maxVoices,voices)
 local root=player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if root then for _,name in {"Running","Climbing"} do local s=root:FindFirstChild(name);if s and s:IsA("Sound") then result.footsteps[name]={volume=s.Volume,id=s.SoundId} end end end
 result.duration=at
 report.Value=game.HttpService:JSONEncode(result)
 task.wait(.1)
end
for _,connection in connections do connection:Disconnect() end
result.done=true
report.Value=game.HttpService:JSONEncode(result)
script:Destroy()
]]
scriptObject.Parent=player.PlayerScripts
return {observing=true,duration=120,bounded=true}
